title: Unified architecture requirements
summary: Stable requirement IDs used by implementation mappings and acceptance evidence.

requirements.statement: One public route in one locale has exactly one content/<locale>/<route>.md source file.
requirements.verification: route inventory plus duplicate negative fixture

requirements.statement: Configuration files contain composition only and reject unknown keys.
content/<locale>/lang.json is the only shared public UI string source; public resources/i18n and site.json compatibility are absent.
Markdown compiles into typed in-memory IR with source provenance and no mandatory page JSON/JSONL.
requirements.verification: in-memory IR tests, optional dump snapshot and error-location tests

requirements.statement: All document nodes use one renderer registry.
All ui.* and docara.* component nodes use one Smart gateway.
requirements.verification: manifest, params, assets and unknown-component tests

requirements.statement: Full and page builds use one PageBuilder pipeline and differ only by selected route set.
requirements.verification: call graph, route-selection trace and semantic parity

requirements.statement: Every declared locale has explicit route and missing-page behavior.
Generated IR, HTML and indexes are disposable.
Engine and Framework inputs are immutable and recorded.
requirements.verification: lock validation and two clean builds

requirements.statement: Legacy paths are deleted only after parity and zero-reference evidence.
Package-owned CLI/build messages are isolated from public page inputs and no architecture acceptance implies release or production readiness.
